summary.text: Jen Strebs is the Democratic candidate for Michigan House of Representatives District 41 in the November 3, 2026 general election, against Nicole Sabel (R) and Rafael Wolf (L); there is no incumbent in the race.
A mental health professional, she says in a Ballotpedia survey that she has worked on climate and medical debt issues in Kalamazoo.

paragraphs.text: Strebs earned a bachelor's degree from Western Michigan University in 2019, and her career experience includes working as a mental health professional.
She defeated Jessica Swartz in the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Strebs listed an affordable cost of living, health care for all, and climate action as her main campaign messages.
She said she has helped eliminate medical debt for thousands of Kalamazoo residents and was involved in securing Kalamazoo's first Climate Action Plan.
She said she would advocate for a single-payer health system, expand Medicaid, and raise wages and worker protections.
